summary: Song Tae-won and Sung Hyun-jae, a couple whose relationship has been strained by misunderstandings and a month-long cold war, finally reconcile. The tension stemmed from Song Tae-won's belief that Sung Hyun-jae was having an affair (due to overheard whispers) and Sung Hyun-jae's secret efforts to commission a custom suit for Song Tae-won's birthday. After a period of emotional distance and physical injuries caused by their mutual distraction, they confront each other on Song Tae-won's birthday. The misunderstanding is cleared, leading to an intense and passionate reconciliation.
